metadata.name: SearchedInventoryDetails
metadata.description: Use this API to fetch details of the inventory using orderID.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: OrderID
request_fields.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: OrderId
children.description: Order number for an inventory. Valid values : 0-9 Example : 3478

children.name: RequestedOn
children.description: Request date time of activity Format: yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss:msi Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00:000

children.name: NumberOfCards
children.description: Total number of cards. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 17

children.name: OrderStatus
children.description: Status of the inventory Valid values : Approval Pending Approved Cards Created Inventory Dispatch Received Inventory Received with return Lost in Transit Damaged in Transit Transfer Received Transfer Received with return Transfer - In Transit Transfer - Lost in Transit Transfer - Damaged in Transit Error Rejected

children.name: BulkShipaddress1
children.description: Address Line 1 of the cardholder. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point

children.name: BulkShipaddress2
children.description: Address Line 2 of the cardholder. Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : 1 mecca way

children.name: City
children.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross

children.name: PostalCode
children.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093

children.name: Country
children.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values

children.name: State
children.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US)

children.name: FICompanyName
children.description: Company name

children.name: AttnName
children.description: Attention name, can be used to store additional information.

children.name: AcctYesNo
children.description: whether Account number should be printed  in embossing file or not. Valid Values : 1 ,2 1= Yes 2= No

children.name: SubAgentID
children.description: Sub-Agent ID associated with the Bank for the Card Program-type. Valid Values: A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example:Test123

children.name: Title
children.description: Title for the customer Valid Values:  Refer Appendix Section : Title Values Example: Mr.

children.name: FirstName
children.description: First Name for Shipping address Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: TestName Condition: It is mandatory when value of DifferentShipToAddress =2

children.name: MiddleName
children.description: Cardholder Middle Name values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Charles

children.name: LastName
children.description: Cardholder Last Name Valid values: A-Z, a-z Example: Hudson

children.name: NameOnCard
children.description: Name to be Embossed on Card Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9. Example: Hudson M Charles

children.name: RequestedBy
children.description: User id of the user who requested the inventory. Example : abc.cc.admin

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Name of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example: Cash card

children.name: ApprovedBy
children.description: UserID  of the person who approved the inventory order. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z, a-z Example:abcd.admin

children.name: ApprovedOn
children.description: Date on which the inventory order was approved Format: yyyy-mm-ddTHH:mm:ss:msi Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00:000

children.name: SourceLocation
children.description: Source location of the inventory

children.name: DestinationLocation
children.description: Destination Address

children.name: AWBNumber
children.description: Indicates the Air Way Bill Number of an inventory transfer Example 156463

children.name: DispatchDate
children.description: Date of inventory dispatch Format: yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss Example:2017-09-26T00:00:00

children.name: InvoiceNumber
children.description: Invoice Number Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Example: AB987567757

children.name: BranchCode
children.description: Branch code from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:C1006

children.name: EmbossingLine4
children.description: Text to be print on Line 4 of a plastic. Valid Values:a-z, A-Z

children.name: ClientName
children.description: Name of the client Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : FirstSearch

children.name: BranchStoreName
children.description: Store Name of the branch Valid values  : A-Z Example - head office.

children.name: Quantity
children.description: Number of cards ordered in inventory Valid values : 0-9 Example : 850

children.name: PlasticCode
children.description: Plastic Code Valid values: 0-9 Example: 32

children.name: PlasticDescription
children.description: Name of the plastic card.

children.name: LogoID
children.description: Logo ID printed on the cards. Valid value:  0-9, A-Z Example : Cash187
